entities.summary: Henri-Jacques-Edouard Evenepoel was a French-born Belgian artist whose most important works are associated with Fauvism. Henri Evenepoel was a painters & sculptors from Nice (1872-10-03, Nice–1899-12-27). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
